notes: Isolated hardened-role setup probe before functional QA. Standard seed fails casting bypass to UUID; operator-only provisioning then creates five test users, but Chrome valid login still returns generic error with the restricted application DB role. Matches existing #644. Readiness was all green, so readiness does not prove identity usability. No role privilege was changed to turn this result into a pass; any later functional configuration is a separate run. No product fixes. Docker runtime socket directories were renamed aside to recover initial startup; no data-volume reset.

definition.title: Authentication, Tokens, and Sessions — systematic Chrome coverage
steps: Login, refresh, replay old token, logout.
Use normal Chrome with the populated Eval account. Record observed UI behavior and unexercised parts separately; do not claim backend-only guarantees from UI evidence.
definition.expected: Valid access works; invalid/revoked refresh tokens fail.

results.reason: Known #644 affects deliberate global lookup under this hardened DB role.
results.residual_risk: Functional login cannot proceed under this role; no RLS pass is claimed.

evidence.description: The isolated app passed readiness and five users were seeded via an operator-only bootstrap connection. Valid owner login in Chrome using the NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS app connection returned a generic sign-in error. Backend/seed paths report InvalidTextRepresentationError on UUID cast of bypass.
Known-valid seeded owner login fails under asserted NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS app role.
